- Live per-NIC status-bar chips (`Wi-Fi`, `Ethernet`, tethers) now report
  accurate download speeds for both HTTP multi-segment downloads and dual-stack
  torrents: sampled on a decoupled `1 s` timer with a `6 s` rate window, IPv6
  interface aliasing, HTTP `LinkSet` connection metering, and initial uplink
  discovery before creating a bonded torrent session.
- Externally deleted or moved files now show an amber `!` badge and
  `File missing` indicator across the GUI, CLI, details view, and browser
  extension duplicate window, disable broken open/seed actions, stop active
  seeding if payload files vanish from disk, and add one-click in-place
  **Re-download** (`ripdl redownload <id>` in CLI).
